threads.body:
The cited `execute_tool` scenarios do not demonstrate this timing requirement. `google-adk/scenario.py:147-151`, `openai-agents/scenario.py:30-35`, and `pydantic-ai/scenario.py:49-54` all add `gen_ai.agent.name` after the span starts, so a sampler cannot read it. Move the library-derived agent name into the attributes passed to `start_as_current_span` in the affected reference scenarios.

This issue also appears on line 698 of the same file.
threads.hunk:
@@ -606,6 +606,8 @@ spans:
           recommended: If available.
       - ref: gen_ai.tool.type
         sampling_relevant: true
+      - ref: gen_ai.agent.name
+        sampling_relevant: true
